## Accepted credited partial result

Under the stated continuous positive trace-class weak-solution assumptions on an infinite-dimensional real separable Hilbert space, injective bounded positive self-adjoint Q forces alpha in N0 for every C0 generator. The generator may be unbounded and its semigroup noninjective; random initial values need no moment assumption. No trace-class integrated covariance or Markov property of compressions is required.

The original source is OWR26/2024 Open problem1 (p1480), corresponding to EJP Open Problem1.2 (p5). It prints alpha notin N without an explicit convention found in this audit. If N excludes zero, alpha0 and X0=Xt=0 is a trivial affirmative exception. The verified negative assertion concerns noninteger alpha outsideN0; zero is allowed and no author convention is inferred.

Anonymous (2026), unrefereed version0.1.0-candidate, Lemma3/Corollary2 and its random-initial scope paragraph, already states this exact obstruction: [immutable source](https://github.com/ipitchford/wishart-reachable-noise/blob/73dd242a4450400e2f8f16b65929cb77fee76be1/paper.md), [prior version DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22892681). We independently verified the narrow proof and archived identity. No first-priority or broader classification claim is made.

## Validation and scope

Three independent stochastic-analysis, finite-reproduction and primary/priority families passed, followed by a fresh complete adversarial review with no outstanding mathematical or current-candidate issues. Historical8+19checks reproduce byte-identically; fresh adversary117checks and211replayed checks pass. Checkable derivations, corruption controls, source checksums and exact hashes accompany the research record. AI tools were used extensively; this is independent AI review, unrefereed by humans and not formal certification.

Changes include the problem's attempt artifacts, their globally reconciled source/zero/attribution metadata, and the target QUEUE.md row, now already_solved for the intended noninteger result. Historical source snapshots, old reviews and the original1/5 ledger are preserved. Accepted as a credited partial research record. No new paper, Zenodo deposit or spreadsheet row is created; the linked DOI belongs to the earlier work.

[Complete fresh audit](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/main/draft_pr_publication_program_20260930/audits/pr14_30005934/final_adversary/REPORT.md).
